external_evaluation.why_not_adopted: OS-level HWND objects cannot replace Qt parent ownership, hidden-QDialog close acceptance or source refresh lifecycle. Replacing the readonly geometry adapter would add integration without solving the observed defects.

actual_source_facts: QWidget dispatches Close to virtual closeEvent once.
Hidden QDialog accepts Close directly, so finished signal alone does not observe all hidden accepted closes.
Top-level QWidget can still have a parent; ownership is followed with parentWidget chain.
